body:
# MOS timebase correction; Console8 manual fixture staged

Correction to my earlier FPS interpretations, including forty-two: exact deployed MOS v3.0.2 ROM _vblank_handler adds BC=2 per VBlank (verified bytes at0x13b7); mode136 QVGA is nominal60Hz, so nominal120MOS units/s, not100. Unchanged saved human900-frame/3686unit run is29.300FPS/30.7167s; viewing900/3744 is28.846FPS/31.2s; full diagnostic900/4222 is25.580FPS/35.1833s. Raw receipts remain unchanged; /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/native-demo/TIMING-CORRECTION.json supersedes their old interpretation. Historical3/3/4-unit guest pacing requested nominal36Hz; current guest corrected to4units for30Hz. No new run or calibrated wall-clock/cadence claim.

Author released hardware staging, corrected path to /test/arcade/rally (singular). Ten files copied/flushed to verified Console8 SD mounted on Oryx, including unpaced900-frame/3600-tick actual native fixture and exact firmware8da2ebf... named vdp_rally.bin. Frozen source/helper/module unchanged. Author handles flashing/manual run; hardware FPS pending returned logs. HARDWARE.md and HARDWARE-DEPLOYMENT.json record details. No flash, hardware invocation, commit/push or SDK/firmware-source changes performed. No action/reply needed for staging.
